title: Amazing Animals
subject: Science
learning_objectives: Sort animals into farm and wild
Count animal legs on a number line

scenes.label: Good morning!
scenes.text: The sun comes up over the *farm*.

scenes.label: Meet the cow
scenes.text: The cow says moo. She is a *farm* animal.
scenes.detail: A cow has one big stomach with four rooms inside for munching grass!

scenes.label: A wild lion
scenes.text: Far away, a lion wakes up. He is *wild*!
scenes.detail: A lion's roar is so loud you can hear it 8 kilometres away.

scenes.label: Every animal has a home
scenes.text: Farm or wild — let's meet them all!

sections.title: Let's meet some animals!
sections.content: Animals live all around the world. Some live on farms. Some live wild in forests and jungles. Let's play!

sections.question: Tap the elephant!
sections.hint: The elephant is the biggest one, with a long trunk.
sections.correct_feedback: Yes! The elephant has a long trunk and big ears.
sections.incorrect_feedback: That's not the elephant. Look for the animal with the long trunk!

sections.instruction: Sort the animals: who lives on the farm, and who lives in the wild?
sections.hint: Farm animals live with people. Wild animals live in the jungle or forest.
sections.correct_feedback: Great sorting! Cows and sheep live on farms. Lions and monkeys live in the wild.
sections.incorrect_feedback: Think about where you would see each animal — on a farm with people, or out in the jungle?

sections.question: A spider has how many legs? Slide the marker!
sections.hint: It is more than 6 and less than 10 — count them in pairs: 2, 4, 6, 8!
sections.correct_feedback: Yes! Spiders have 8 legs — that's why they are not insects.
sections.incorrect_feedback: Count again in twos: 2, 4, 6, 8. A spider has 8 legs!

sections.question: Which animal can fly?
sections.hint: Look for the animal with wings and feathers.
sections.correct_feedback: Correct! Owls have wings and can fly at night.
sections.incorrect_feedback: Turtles and rabbits can't fly — the owl has wings and feathers!

completion_message: Roar-some work! You know your animals, where they live, and how to count their legs!
